$summary: Background roles — the surface ladder, from the page canvas up to the most recessed well.

theme.bg.canvas.summary: The page's own background, behind every surface.
use: Any full-bleed region that is not itself a raised surface.
dont: Card, dialog, menu, or dropdown backgrounds — those are theme.bg.surface, one step up so they read as raised.

theme.bg.surface.summary: A raised surface sitting on top of the canvas — the default background for any container with an edge.
use: Card, dialog, menu, popover, and dropdown backgrounds.
dont: The page background itself — that is theme.bg.canvas.

theme.bg.subtle.summary: A quiet, faintly recessed or striped background — one step of emphasis below a surface, without reading as an interactive control.
use: Table header rows and zebra stripes.
A quiet section band inside a surface.
dont: An interactive hover/press background — use .rata-state-layer instead of a static fill.

theme.bg.muted.summary: The most recessed background — an inset well, a track, or a skeleton-loading placeholder.
use: A progress track behind its filled bar.
An inset search field or well.

instead.Body text on this background: theme.fg.secondary, not theme.fg.muted, which falls to AA-large here
